parameters.name: delivery_locations
parameters.description: Set of delivery location indices from 0 to S-1.

parameters.name: aggregate_demand
parameters.description: Total aggregate demand to be delivered across the horizon.

parameters.name: location_demand
parameters.description: Demand at each delivery location when location-level demand is provided.

parameters.name: trip_capacity
parameters.description: Trip capacity of each transportation mode.

parameters.name: pollution_per_trip
parameters.description: Pollution generated by one trip of each transportation mode.

parameters.name: minimum_truck_trips
parameters.description: Minimum required number of truck trips.

parameters.name: exclusive_mode_pairs
parameters.description: List of mutually exclusive mode pairs, including any enforced pair such as van and electric vehicle.

variables.name: trip_count_by_mode
variables.description: Integer number of trips assigned to each transportation mode.

variables.name: mode_usage_indicator
variables.description: Binary indicator equal to 1 if a mode is used, and 0 otherwise.

variables.name: transported_quantity_by_mode
variables.description: Quantity transported using each transportation mode.

variables.name: total_quantity_delivered
variables.description: Total quantity delivered across all modes.

variables.name: total_pollution_generated
variables.description: Total pollution generated by the transportation plan.

auxiliary_variables.name: big_m_trip_count_upper_bound
auxiliary_variables.description: Upper bound on the number of trips for each mode used in the indicator linking constraint.

constraints.name: demand_satisfaction
constraints.description: The plan must deliver enough total quantity to satisfy the required demand, using the total demand implied by the input instance.

constraints.name: pollution_budget
constraints.description: Total pollution generated by the transportation plan must not exceed the maximum allowable pollution.

constraints.name: minimum_truck_trips
constraints.description: The truck mode must be used at least the minimum required number of times.

constraints.name: van_electric_vehicle_exclusivity
constraints.description: The van mode and the electric vehicle mode cannot both be used in the same plan.

constraints.name: trip_capacity_consistency
constraints.description: For each transportation mode, transported quantity must be consistent with trip count and trip capacity.

constraints.name: mode_usage_indicator_logic
constraints.description: Mode-usage indicators must correctly reflect whether each mode is used, using finite upper bounds on trip counts.

constraints.name: additional_exclusive_mode_pairs
constraints.description: Any additional mutually exclusive mode pairs listed in the exclusive pair set must be respected.

constraints.name: location_level_demand_satisfaction
constraints.description: If the instance provides location-level demands instead of an aggregate demand, the total delivered quantity must cover the sum of all location demands.

objectives.name: minimize_total_pollution
objectives.description: Minimize the total pollution generated by the transportation plan.

final_objective.description: Minimize the total pollution generated by the transportation plan.
